examples.text: tesu anotattadaho sudassanakūṭaṃ cittakūṭaṃ kāḷakūṭaṃ gandhamādanakūṭaṃ kelāsakūṭan'ti imehi pañcahi pabbatakūṭehi parikkhitto.

78782.meaning1: name of one of the five mountains surrounding lake Anotatta in the Himalayas
78782.commentary: (UDa) gandhamādanakūṭaṃ masāragallamayaṃ abbhantare muggavaṇṇaṃ, mūlagandho, sāragandho, pheggugandho, tacagandho, papaṭikāgandho, khandhagandho, rasagandho, pupphagandho, phalagandho, pattagandho'ti imehi dasahi gandhehi ussannaṃ, nānappakāraosadhasañchannaṃ, kāḷapakkh'uposathadivase ādittaṃ viya aṅgāraṃ pajjalantaṃ tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: tesu anotattadaho sudassanakūṭaṃ cittakūṭaṃ kāḷakūṭaṃ gandhamādanakūṭaṃ kelāsakūṭan'ti imehi pañcahi pabbatakūṭehi parikkhitto.
pakkhijāto tadā āsiṃ, supaṇṇo garuḷādhipo, addasaṃ virajaṃ buddhaṃ, gacchantaṃ gandhamādanaṃ.
tattha sudassanakūṭaṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ dviyojanasat'ubbedhaṃ antovaṅkaṃ kākamukhasaṇṭhānaṃ tam'eva saraṃ paṭicchādetvā ṭhitaṃ.
tattha sudassanakūṭaṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ dviyojanasat'ubbedhaṃ antovaṅkaṃ kākamukhasaṇṭhānaṃ tam'eva saraṃ paṭicchādetvā ṭhitaṃ.

78788.meaning1: (gram) elision of the last word in a compound

examples.text: pariyosito'ti pariyositabhojano, uttarapadalopo daṭṭhabbo. yāvatakaṃ bhuñjitabbaṃ, tāvatakaṃ bhuttaṃ hoti, avasitā me bhojanakiriyā'ti attho.

78789.meaning1: (gram) elision of the first word in a compound

examples.text: kūṭan'ti aṃsakūṭaṃ vuttaṃ purimapadalopena, kūṭam'eva aṅgan'ti kūṭ'aṅgaṃ, taṃ chindatī'ti kūṭaṅ'gacchi.
kūṭan'ti aṃsakūṭaṃ vuttaṃ purimapadalopena, kūṭam'eva aṅgan'ti kūṭ'aṅgaṃ, taṃ chindatī'ti kūṭaṅ'gacchi.
upādānakkhandhā'ti upādānagocarā khandhā, majjhapadalopo daṭṭhabbo. upādānasambhūtā vā khandhā upādānakkhandhā yathā tiṇ'aggi thus'aggi.

78793.commentary: (JAa) tipallatthan'ti pallatthaṃ vuccati sayanaṃ, ubhohi passehi ujukam'eva ca nipannakavasenā'ti tīh'ākārehi pallatthaṃ assa, tīṇi vā pallatthāni assā'ti tipallattho, taṃ tipallatthaṃ.

examples.text: migaṃ tipallattham'anekamāyaṃ, aṭṭhakkhuraṃ aḍḍharatt'āpapāyiṃ, ekena sotena cham'āssasanto, chahi kalāhi'tibhoti bhāgineyyo'ti.

78794.meaning1: beneficial; profitable; advantageous; having good results
78794.synonym: atthakara, atthasañhita, atthasaṃhita, atthika, atthiya, atthūpasaṃhita, saudraya, sātthaka

examples.text: saphalā'ti sānisaṃsā. saudrayā'ti savaḍḍhi.

78795.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; Buddha's foster-mother; first Bhikkhunī; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in long-standing
78795.commentary: (ANa) mahāpajāpatī'ti puttapajāya c'eva dhītupajāya ca mahantattā evaṃladdhanāmā.
78795.notes: Therīgāthā verses 157-162 (TH6.6, TH55) are attributed to her.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodh'ārāme. atha kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

78796.commentary: (BVa) tassa tissassa bhagavato aparabhāge anukkamena parihāyitvā puna vaḍḍhitvā aparimitāyukā hutvā anupubbena hāyitvā navutivassasahass'āyukesu jātesu tasmiṃ'y'eva kappe phusso nāma satthā loke uppajji.

examples.text: tatth'eva maṇḍakappamhi, ahu satthā anuttaro, anupamo asamasamo, phusso lok'agganāyako.
brahmunā yācito santo, tisso lok'agganāyako, vatti cakkaṃ mahāvīro, yasavatiyam'uttame.

78798.commentary: (BVa) dhammadassimhi bhagavati parinibbute antarahite c'assa sāsane tasmiṃ kappe atīte kappasahasse ca sattasu kappasatesu ca chasu kappesu ca atikkantesu ito catunavutikappamatthake ekasmiṃ kappe eko'va lokatthacaro adhigataparam'attho siddhattho nāma satthā loke pāturahosi

examples.text: jambuto phalam'ānetvā, siddhatthassa adās'ahaṃ, paṭiggahetvā sambuddho, idaṃ vacanam'abravi.

78799.meaningLit: who sees the nature of things
78799.commentary: (BVa) atthadassimhi sammāsambuddhe parinibbute antarakappe ca vītivatte aparimitāyukesu sattesu anupubbena parihāyitvā vassasatasahass'āyukesu jātesu dhammadassī nāma satthā lokālokakaro lobhādilokamalavinayakaro lokekanāyako loke udapādi.

examples.text: yadā buddho dhammadassī, vinesi sañjayaṃ isiṃ, tadā navutikoṭīnaṃ, dutiy'ābhisamayo ahu.
